$Comment: Seasons of Orbis, the top rung of the ladder: a keepsake kept from every season this server runs.
MetaSelector writes no Needs, so it asks for every season it finds: each season whose yearly
keepsake carries the season_keepsake tag, any year's copy standing for it. A new season raises
the count, and a player who already earned this keeps it. A season a server owner switches off
in calendar.json leaves the count, so this stays within reach. It pays the title
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Every_Season through the Title reward kind.
Keep this file's name: it is the id every player's progress on it is filed under. Filed under
Seasons with no subcategory, which is where the Almanac looks for its banner.
